sourceValue.script: function run(){ var input=JSON.parse(context.getBody()); var pairs=JSON.parse(context.getPersistedItem('pairs')||'{}'); var existing=pairs[input.pairId]; if(input.operation==='getPair'){ if(!existing){context.setBody(JSON.stringify({status:'not-found'})); return;} context.setBody(JSON.stringify({status:'ok',recordVersion:1,publicRecord:existing.publicRecord,secretRecord:input.includeSecret?existing.secretRecord:undefined})); return; } if(input.operation==='putPairIfAbsent'){ if(existing){context.setBody(JSON.stringify({status:'conflict',recordVersion:1,error:'pair already exists'})); return;} pairs[input.pairId]={publicRecordId:input.publicRecordId,secretRecordId:input.secretRecordId,publicRecord:input.publicRecord,secretRecord:input.secretRecord}; context.setPersistedItem('pairs',JSON.stringify(pairs)); context.setBody(JSON.stringify({status:'created',recordVersion:1})); return;} throw new Error('unsupported DynamoDB mock operation'); } run();

resultsProcessor.script: function call(request) { var response = context.sendToStep('accept-storage', JSON.stringify(request)); if (response.isErrored()) throw new Error(response.getAllErrors()[0]); return JSON.parse(response.getBody()); } var publicRecord = { format: 'opscotch-key-store/key-record/v2', recordType: 'public' }; var secretRecord = { format: 'opscotch-key-store/key-record/v2', recordType: 'secret' }; var get = { operation: 'getPair', pairId: 'dynamodb-pair', publicRecordId: 'public', secretRecordId: 'secret', includeSecret: true }; var put = { operation: 'putPairIfAbsent', pairId: 'dynamodb-pair', publicRecordId: 'public', secretRecordId: 'secret', publicRecord: publicRecord, secretRecord: secretRecord }; if (call(get).status !== 'not-found') throw new Error('expected missing pair'); if (call(put).status !== 'created') throw new Error('expected pair creation'); if (call(get).status !== 'ok') throw new Error('expected pair retrieval'); if (call(put).status !== 'conflict') throw new Error('expected pair conflict'); context.sendMetric('storage-dynamodb-contract-pass', 1.0);
